method: Inspected all 40 final pages in four contact sheets and detailed trajectory, final body, actual-input and first experiment-table pages. Publication layout review only.
checks: Ten body pages plus one references page.
No clipped figure labels or overlapping table cells observed; compiler reports no overflow or missing glyphs.
Eight-panel Arena rows preserve shared prefix and incident; all omitted decisions are in the ledger.
Archived v2 API runs are labeled separately from current v3 protocol and unmeasured study tables.
White stud plate is visible and exported from the sensor grid without changing episode state.
Actual input images remain original 800 by 600 bytes; high-resolution publication states are explicitly distinct.
Thirty blank experiment sheets, ten candidate model labels and all 310 object IDs remain present.
Supplement section heading and first result sheets share a page; no isolated introductory page.
Comic Sans MS is embedded in every referenced figure PDF.
figureTypography: Comic Sans MS regular and bold
